name: Diminishing Armband
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This simple leather armband is decorated with a row of geometric shapes that grow smaller as they circle the band. Useful for spies and thieves, once per day the wearer can cast reduce person on themselves as a swift action. This effect lasts for 2 hours and may be dismissed by the wearer as a free action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, reduce person
